debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r s-c-r-i-p-t-e-d l-o-g-i-n a-t-t-e-m-p-t-s t-o t-a-r-g-e-t l-o-y-a-l-t-y a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s and l-e-f-t a n-u-m-b-e-r e-d e-n-d-p-o-i-n-t l-o-g while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-a-t-e l-i-m-i-t a-l-e-r-t
2) the a-c-t-o-r c-a-p-t-u-r-e-d s-e-s-s-i-o-n c-o-o-k-i-e-s a-f-t-e-r p-a-s-s-w-o-r-d b-y-p-a-s-s and l-e-f-t a c-o-o-k-i-e d-u-m-p on the l-o-c-a-l d-i-s-k while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y t-r-a-i-l r-e-v-i-e-w
3) the a-c-t-o-r c-o-n-v-e-r-t-e-d g-i-f-t-c-a-r-d v-a-l-u-e in-t-o m-e-r-c-h-a-n-t-i-s-e a-n-d l-e-f-t a p-r-o-c-e-s-s e-d r-e-c-e-i-p-t c-h-a-i-n while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the t-h-r-e-s-h-o-l-d a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l
4) the a-c-t-o-r p-a-t-t-e-r-n-e-d o-r-d-e-r-s l-i-k-e l-e-g-i-t i-m p-u-r-c-h-a-s-e-s a-n-d l-e-f-t a n-o-t-e-o-f-s-a-l-e c-o-m-p-i-l-a-t-i-o-n while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s
5) the a-c-t-o-r c-l-e-a-n-s-e-d c-a-s-h o-u-t r-e-c-o-r-d-s t-o h-i-d-e m-o-v-e-m-e-n-t and l-e-f-t a p-a-r-t-i-a-l d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e e-x-p-o-r-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l c-l-o-s-u-r-e
